description.zh:
发信地址。

> 不填，代表所有地址；若有TagName，此参数不为空。
description.en:
The sender address.

> If you leave this parameter empty, data for all addresses is returned. This parameter is required if you specify TagName.

description.zh:
对于独立IP用户，查询特定的独立IP的数据。

不填写此参数时默认查询所有数据。
description.en:
The dedicated IP address. This parameter is available only for users of dedicated IPs.

If you do not specify this parameter, data for all IPs is returned.

description.zh:
对于独立IP用户，查询特定的独立IP池ID的数据

不填写此参数时默认查询所有数据。
description.en:
The ID of the dedicated IP pool. This parameter is available only for users of dedicated IPs.

If you do not specify this parameter, data for all IP pools is returned.

description.zh: 结束时间，和起始时间跨度不能超出15天，格式yyyy-MM-dd。
description.en: The end time. The time span between the start time and end time cannot exceed 15 days. The format is yyyy-MM-dd.

description.zh:
对于独立IP用户，查询特定的ESP数据的数据，可以填写的值如下
- gmail.com
- yahoo.com
- outlook.com
- icloud.com
- others（对应其他的非上述ESP的数据）

不填写此参数时默认查询所有数据。
description.en:
The Email Service Provider (ESP). This parameter is available only for users of dedicated IPs. Valid values:

- gmail.com

- yahoo.com

- outlook.com

- icloud.com

- others (data for ESPs other than the ones listed above)

If you do not specify this parameter, data for all ESPs is returned.

description.zh: 第一次查询为0，后续固定为1。1为按照时间正序分页查询。（本字段已废弃）
description.en: The value is 0 for the first query and 1 for subsequent queries. A value of 1 indicates a paged query in chronological order. (This field is deprecated)

description.zh: 分页用，第一次查询不设置，后续查询设置为上一次Response中OffsetCreateTime值（本字段已废弃）
description.en: Used for paging. Do not set this parameter for the first query. For subsequent queries, set this parameter to the OffsetCreateTime value from the previous response. (This field is deprecated)
The number of entries per page.

description.zh: 起始时间，时间不能早于30日，格式yyyy-MM-dd。
description.en: The start time. The time cannot be earlier than 30 days ago. The format is yyyy-MM-dd.

description.zh: 邮件标签。不填，代表所有标签。
description.en: The email tag. If you leave this parameter empty, data for all tags is returned.

title.zh: 根据发信地址和标签获取邮件跟踪发送数据
title.en: Retrieve email tracking sending data by sender address and label

example.legacyCli: aliyun dm GetTrackListByMailFromAndTagName --region cn-hangzhou --DedicatedIpPoolId xxx --Esp 'gmail.com' --EndTime '2019-09-29' --PageSize 10 --TagName Subscription --DedicatedIp 'xxx.xxx.xxx.xxx' --StartTime '2019-09-29' --OffsetCreateTimeDesc 'This_field_is_deprecated.' --Offset 'This_field_is_deprecated.' --OffsetCreateTime 'This_field_is_deprecated.' --PageNumber 1 --Total 'This_field_is_deprecated.' --ConfigSetId xxx --AccountName 'e-service@amegroups.cn'
